facts.fact: La Nation reports the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation presented a 2027 draft budget of FCFA 11.59bn to the National Assembly, with FCFA 7.74bn of investment financed wholly from own resources.
facts.system: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation 2027 draft budget

facts.fact: La Nation reports the ministry's 2027 draft budget of FCFA 11.59bn against FCFA 16,483,428,674 in 2026, a fall (printed as 29.29%) attributed to the externally financed Pitn2r project leaving its portfolio.
facts.system: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation 2027 draft budget
